items.title: RMD Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressures Weigh Despite Product Momentum and Portfolio Shifts
items.summary: Medical device company ResMed (NYSE:RMD) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.6% year on year to $1.46 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.95 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
